moments.label: God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment hath taken hold on me. The Lord said he is hurt for the hurt of his people. So how much more should we be? Are we not his people? Are we not in error? God is hurt for us, to see us in this condition.

note.label: God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered? Is there no healing in Gilead? Why? Because there is no leader to teach them, to lead them to God. Well, God said the hour cometh when the true worshippers are going to worship him in spirit and truth. There are going to be leaders that are going to rise up in the last days and revive the people, that care about the hurt of the people.

note.label: God's People Need Charity, Healing & Trust

points: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt: for the pain, for the suffering of my people. So as a prophet, as an Israelite, we're going to feel an attachment, a compassion, sympathy, and empathy for our people when they being put to death, when they being mistreated, when they being wrongfully incarcerated, when they being given 35 years for self-defense. We're going to feel some type of way about our people. It is natural to do so.

For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace. That slight healing was the civil rights settlement: the leaders said peace, the white man has changed, he is not lynching us any more. But the institutions were built on racism and set up to keep us at the bottom of society, and the work simply moved out of sight. Slightly healed is not healed.

This is a good present to use against the comedic brothers, the biblical doubters and heretics who mock the Bible asking where the bones of David, of Jeremiah, of Moses are. The scripture answers it: the bones of our forefathers were scattered and not buried, spread all over the earth. That is why you will not find them.

note.label: Jeremiah 8: No Peace, No Salvation for a Backsliding People

points: We do not understand how much mercy the Most High has shown the nation of Israel. Read from the beginning up until today and you see much mercy; we deserve all the persecution we get because we have a perpetual backsliding and refuse to return.

note.label: Jeremiah 8: No Peace, No Salvation for a Backsliding People

points: Our people do not want to acknowledge their sins. No man repents saying "what have I done"; everyone turns to his own course like a horse rushing into battle.

note.label: Jeremiah 8: No Peace, No Salvation for a Backsliding People

points: Even the stork, the turtle, the crane and the swallow know their appointed times, but the Most High's people know not His judgment. The people claim to be wise and to have the law, but they have rejected the word of the Lord, so what wisdom is in them.

note.label: Jeremiah 8: No Peace, No Salvation for a Backsliding People

points: The prophets and priests healed the hurt of the daughter of the people only slightly, saying peace, peace when there is no peace.

note.label: Jeremiah 8: No Peace, No Salvation for a Backsliding People

points: They committed abomination yet were not ashamed and could not even blush; therefore they shall fall in the time of their visitation.

note.label: Jeremiah 8: No Peace, No Salvation for a Backsliding People

points: The harvest is passed, the summer is ended, and we are not saved. Our people think they are already redeemed and saved in the blood of Jesus, but no. We are still being murdered in the streets, locked up, persecuted, last hired and first fired, oppressed systematically and hated. We still have no land, no country, no standard, no god of our own, and the majority of Israelites do not even know they are Israelites and worship a white Jesus. We are not saved.

note.label: Jeremiah 8: No Peace, No Salvation for a Backsliding People

points: For the hurt of the daughter of the people the prophet is hurt and black astonishment takes hold of him. Is there no balm in Gilead, is there no physician there, so why is the health of the people not recovered.
